— along with explicit user consent — to access a user’s home automation network. An app stores its entitlements as key-value pairs embedded in the code signature of its binary executable.
You configure entitlements for your app by declaring capabilities for a target in Xcode; see
. Xcode records capabilities that you add in a property list file with the
extension. When code signing your app, Xcode combines the entitlements file, information from your developer account, and other project information to apply a final set of entitlements to your app.
You typically let Xcode manage the entitlements file for you.
